cohort: The study included 94 patients with sonographically detected uterine scar defects who subsequently underwent laparoscopy at the University Clinic St. Hedwig in Regensburg between 2020 and 2024.
finding: Extragenital endometriosis was histologically confirmed in 47.9% of patients with symptomatic or large uterine niches, showing a significant association with heavy menstrual bleeding and retroflexio uteri.
mod_finding: Almost half of the patients with symptomatic uterine niches, which result from previous cesarean sections, were found to have extragenital endometriosis, supporting the hypothesis of retrograde menstruation.
